executive_summary: The FitGear Pro Meta account has significant audience overlap issues causing an estimated $2,850/month (10%) in wasted spend. The two most critical issues are: (1) No retargeting exclusions in prospecting campaigns - you're paying prospecting prices ($27+) for retargeting-quality leads ($16). (2) Three overlapping lookalike audiences with 45-68% overlap - you're bidding against yourself. Implementing the recommended exclusions and LAL restructure should reduce blended CPA by 8% and generate ~95 additional conversions at the same spend level.
